AboutPage.heroTitle: Healthcare that tells you the truth about the wait.
AboutPage.heroSubtitle: Doctor Contact connects patients with verified doctors, clinics, and diagnostic centers — with a live queue you can actually see, instead of a waiting room you can only guess at.
AboutPage.storyP1: Doctor Contact started with a simple frustration: patients showing up early and waiting for hours with no idea how many people were ahead of them, while clinics ran their queues on paper registers and guesswork. We built a platform where every token, every schedule, and every queue update happens in real time, on one system, whether you're booking online, walking in, or being seen by a receptionist.
AboutPage.storyP2: Today the platform brings doctors, clinics, receptionists, diagnostic centers, and patients onto one shared source of truth, in Bengali, Hindi, and English, so care stays understandable for the people who need it most.

audiences.title: Patients
audiences.body: Search doctors and clinics, book a token online or arrive as a walk-in, and track your place in the queue and estimated wait time in real time.

audiences.title: Clinics & Doctors
audiences.body: Manage schedules across multiple clinics, control the queue live, and see patient load at a glance — no separate register for online and walk-in patients.

audiences.title: Diagnostic Centers
audiences.body: Receive test referrals directly from doctors and clinics, manage available tests, and keep every referral traceable back to the visit it came from.

values.title: Real-time, not guesswork
values.body: Queue status, doctor availability, and wait times are calculated live from what's actually happening at the clinic, never a static estimate.

values.title: Built for every language
values.body: The platform is available in Bengali, Hindi, and English, because healthcare information should never be gatekept by language.

values.title: Careful with your data
values.body: Appointment and queue information is shared only with the doctor or clinic you're booking with — never sold, never used for anything else.

TermsPage.title: Terms & Conditions
TermsPage.intro: These Terms & Conditions govern your use of the Doctor Contact platform, operated by Dewasi Group. By creating an account or using the platform, you agree to these terms.

sections.title: Acceptance of Terms
body: By registering for or using Doctor Contact as a patient, doctor, clinic, receptionist, diagnostic center, or administrator, you agree to be bound by these Terms & Conditions and our Privacy Policy. If you do not agree, please do not use the platform.

sections.title: What Doctor Contact Does
body: Doctor Contact is a booking and queue-management platform that connects patients with doctors, clinics, and diagnostic centers. We help you find a doctor, book an appointment token, and track queue status in real time.
We do not employ doctors or operate clinics ourselves — clinics and doctors remain independently responsible for the medical care they provide.

sections.title: Accounts & Roles
body: You are responsible for keeping your login credentials confidential and for all activity under your account.
Clinics are responsible for the accuracy of the doctor, staff, and schedule information they add to the platform. Receptionist and staff accounts are created and managed by the clinic they belong to.

sections.title: Appointments, Tokens & Queue
body: A queue token confirms your place in a doctor's queue for a session; it is not a guaranteed consultation time. Wait times shown on the platform are estimates based on current queue activity and can change if a doctor is delayed, a session runs long, or the clinic closes unexpectedly.
Clinics and receptionists may cancel or reschedule appointments in line with the clinic's own policies.

sections.title: Medical Disclaimer
body: Doctor Contact is a scheduling and information platform. It does not provide medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment, and nothing on the platform should be treated as a substitute for professional medical judgment.
In a medical emergency, contact your local emergency services immediately instead of using the platform.

sections.title: Fees & Payments
body: Consultation fees shown on the platform are indicative and set by the clinic or doctor. Payment for consultations and services is currently handled directly at the clinic or diagnostic center, not through the platform.

sections.title: Acceptable Use
body: You agree not to misuse the platform, including submitting false patient or clinic information, booking appointments you don't intend to attend, or interfering with the queue system for other patients.

sections.title: Clinic & Diagnostic Center Listings
body: Clinics and diagnostic centers are responsible for the accuracy of their own listings, working hours, doctor schedules, and available tests. Doctor Contact may verify, feature, or remove listings at its discretion to maintain the quality of the platform.

sections.title: Intellectual Property
body: The Doctor Contact name, logo, and platform design are the property of Dewasi Group. You may not copy, reproduce, or reuse them without written permission.

sections.title: Limitation of Liability
body: Doctor Contact is not liable for the quality of medical care provided by any doctor or clinic, for missed appointments due to inaccurate schedule information supplied by a clinic, or for delays outside the platform's control.

sections.title: Changes to These Terms
body: We may update these Terms & Conditions from time to time. Continued use of the platform after an update means you accept the revised terms.

sections.title: Governing Law
body: These terms are governed by the laws of India.

PrivacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
PrivacyPage.intro: This Privacy Policy explains what information Doctor Contact collects, how we use it, and the choices you have. It applies to patients, doctors, clinics, receptionists, and diagnostic centers using the platform.

sections.title: Information We Collect
body: We collect the information you provide when creating an account or booking an appointment — such as your name, phone number, email, date of birth, and gender for patients, and clinic, qualification, and schedule details for doctors and clinics.
We also record appointment and queue activity, such as which doctor and clinic you booked with and your token status.

sections.title: How We Use Your Information
body: We use this information to create and manage your account, process bookings, generate queue tokens, send appointment and queue notifications, and show you relevant doctors, clinics, and diagnostic centers.

sections.title: What We Don't Collect
body: Doctor Contact does not currently store prescriptions, diagnoses, or detailed medical records. Test referrals record only the names of tests requested, not results.

sections.title: Sharing Your Information
body: Your appointment details are shared only with the doctor, clinic, or diagnostic center you book with, and with staff they authorize to manage their queue. We do not sell your personal information to third parties.

sections.title: Data Security
body: We use industry-standard measures, including encrypted passwords and secure connections, to protect your information. No system is completely secure, and we encourage you to keep your login credentials private.

sections.title: Your Rights
body: You can review and update your profile information from your account settings at any time. To request deletion of your account or data, contact us using the details below.

sections.title: Cookies & Similar Technologies
body: We use essential cookies and local storage to keep you signed in and remember your language preference. We do not use these to track you across other websites.

sections.title: Children's Privacy
body: Doctor Contact is intended for use by adults booking appointments for themselves or on behalf of family members, including children. We do not knowingly collect account information directly from children.

sections.title: Changes to This Policy
body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Significant changes will be reflected with an updated "last updated" date above.
